title: Turkish EV Charging Intent Dataset
subtitle: 192 Turkish EV charging queries across eight balanced intent classes
description: A compact Turkish-language text-classification dataset for EV and charging assistants. The 192 synthetic-editorial queries are balanced across eight intent classes and include fixed train, validation, and test splits. This is not search-log or customer data and contains no personal data. Canonical source: https://github.com/gokimedia/turkish-ev-charging-intents — Documentation: https://tekpedal.com/acik-veri

resources.description: All 192 examples, including the original fixed split label.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Synthetic-editorial Turkish EV or charging query.

fields.name: intent
fields.description: One of eight intent identifiers; the default prediction target.

fields.name: target_path
fields.description: Suggested TekPedal content route for the intent.
